facts.value: Admissions in doctorate Biomedical Science courses in India are done through an entrance exam conducted by the concerned university followed by a personal interview.
facts.programme_association: Biomedical Science - BSc | University of Limerick

facts.value: Candidates who have completed GATE/ UGC NET/ UGC CSIR/ SLET examination are exempted from the university level entrance exam but have to appear for the personal interviews to secure a seat in the program.
facts.programme_association: Biomedical Science - BSc | University of Limerick

facts.value: Students need to have a master’s in biomedical sciences, biomedical engineering, or a relevant science discipline degree with a minimum aggregate of 60% marks from a recognized institute.
facts.programme_association: Biomedical Science - BSc | University of Limerick
